tools.name: mapsdata_search_categories
tools.description: Search the Google Maps business categories MapsData can scrape. CALL THIS FIRST, before mapsdata_start_scrape: a scrape's query must be one of these exact categories, and a free-text guess like 'plumbing companies' is rejected.

tools.name: mapsdata_list_regions
tools.description: List the exact region names a scrape accepts for a country. Submit them verbatim. Abbreviations like 'TX' are rejected; use the full name.

tools.name: mapsdata_start_scrape
tools.description:
Start scraping Google Maps businesses and their emails. Returns IMMEDIATELY with a job id; the scrape itself takes 5 minutes to several hours.

Before calling this, confirm the category with mapsdata_search_categories and the region with mapsdata_list_regions. Those two mistakes are the overwhelming

tools.name: mapsdata_get_scrape
tools.description: Get the current state of one scrape. This is an INSTANT SNAPSHOT of a job that runs for minutes to hours. Do NOT call it repeatedly in a loop. The response includes next_action, the suggested next step for the job's current status. MapsData also emails the user when a scrape finishes.

tools.name: mapsdata_list_scrapes
tools.description: List this workspace's recent scrapes, newest first.

tools.name: mapsdata_cancel_scrape
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running scrape. A queued scrape costs nothing. CANCELLING A RUNNING SCRAPE STILL BILLS the leads already delivered, so confirm with the user before calling this.

tools.name: mapsdata_get_download_link
tools.description: Get a link to a finished scrape's results. The link expires in 15 minutes, so hand it to the user promptly rather than storing it.

tools.name: mapsdata_get_usage
tools.description: How much of this month's lead allowance is left, and the largest single scrape this plan allows. Read max_rows_this_scrape before choosing a total_limit.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "mapsdata_start_scrape" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mapsdata_start_scrape, mapsdata_get_scrape · Public sink: mapsdata_list_regions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mapsdata_start_scrape, mapsdata_get_scrape · Public sink: mapsdata_list_regions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
